items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And come to find out it was Johnny Hodges, covered up in the bed.

ctx.x: Yes, Johnny Hodges. So Marge came on upstairs you know and got off at the wrong floor but the same room you know. Boy she looked in there and Johnny had his head covered up you know. She couldn't see who he was there. And she give Johnny hell. (LAUGHTER).

She said, oh yes, that's why you wanted to leave. Looked like I had to leave her in someone's room to come upstairs see. And so she said, oh yes, that's why you wanted to leave me and come upstairs, see. And come to find out it was Johnny Hodges, covered up in the bed. And (Cue) was scared to death you know. (LAUGHTER). And it was really something. Because Marge can.....
